summary.intent: Fix a regression on PR #630 where BumpReason served both as the release PR Reason text and as changelog-generation input, so a fresh trigger under a retained major lost its changelog entry. Split the two meanings, with a type-level design (trigger vs severity_sources) per the lead's follow-up.
summary.outcome: Seed::reason was restored to the fresh trigger, and the plan entry now carries a separate severity_sources type that is carried through the release preview and rendered as 'major from <changeset>' in the Reason cell. Four end-to-end tests were added, the full gate (just pre-push, lint, doc-check, test) passed, and the work was committed locally in a worktree without pushing.

repo: BumpReason served two jobs: the release PR Reason text and the input for changelog generation (inference reasons emit commit subject and SHA; group reasons emit the group note). Changing it to follow planned severity dropped the fresh commit from changelog sections because retained notes are excluded from new entries.
Retained changeset ids in pre-cycle v3 appear as `pre/<id>` (e.g. `pre/breaking`), not bare ids.
Changelog entries for inferred commits drop the conventional-commit prefix (`fix: repair the parser` becomes `repair the parser`).
A member released by a fixed group whose own retained major sets the bump gets reason 'Fixed group `pair`' with no 'major from' suffix, because the group itself asks for the major.
Adding a field to PlannedBump touched about 70 test struct literals across graph and CLI crates, so a script was used to insert it.
Several tests drive real `npm` (prepack, pack) and fail inside the sandbox because `~/.npm` is not writable; they pass when run outside it.
Preview JSON schema is guarded by crates/callisto-cli/tests/schema_guard_test.rs; no docs or snapshots enumerate preview keys. The release PR body spec lives in docs/specs/release.json.
The existing pre-cycle e2e harness is in crates/callisto-cli/tests/pre_v3_tests.rs; compose-pr-body --preview reads the version --emit-preview JSON.

code.finding: Seed::reason was changed by commit 301d3ca6b to pick changesets at the planned severity; this is the root cause of the regression and was restored to fresh-trigger semantics.
Inference reasons emit the commit subject and SHA into changelog entries; this is a changelog consumer that must read only the trigger.
Group reasons emit the group note into changelog entries and are another trigger-only consumer.
Retained notes are excluded from new changelog entries, which is why a changeset reason under a retained major loses the commit.

friction: Design doc .claude/plans/DESIGN-type-level-invariants.md was missing from the main checkout, so section 1 could not be read.
Sandbox blocked npm writes to ~/.npm, producing false test failures and requiring reruns outside the sandbox.
The initial design (raised_by on the plan entry) was reworked after the lead's follow-up, costing a rename pass and test edits.
Initial test expectations were wrong in three ways (retained id format `pre/breaking`, changelog prefix stripping, group-member reason) and needed correcting after running.
CARGO_BUILD_JOBS had to be computed manually (cores/5); the sysctl-based expression failed and it was hardcoded to 3.
